label: Incomprehensible: primitive versus infinite and comprehended by no caused intellect
resolution: The Dei Filius attributes (incomprehensible conjunct) and the bridge 'Whatever is INFINITE_1 is INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1' use INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1, the primitive Primitives.Incomprehensible (no created intellect knows g as perfectly as g is knowable). INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 (IsIncomprehensibleToCausedIntellects) types its quantifier structure and its q.12 a.7 ground: g is INFINITE_1 and no caused intellect stands in the primitive relation Comprehends to g. They differ in content, not only in strength: INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 ranges over caused (not created-from-nothing) intellects and uses a primitive relation whose identification with knowing as perfectly as knowable is not typed; neither is defined from the other and they are not identified. One statement relates them: the open sense bridge 'Whatever is INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 is INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1'. Only an argument that lists it in sense_bridges passes from INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 to INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1 (the routes nineGiveDeiFiliusImmenseIncomprehensibleTyped and deiFiliusRootImmenseIncomprehensibleTyped); the controls of DeiFiliusImmenseIncomprehensible show that without it a being with the nine can be INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 and not INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1. Neither sense is unknowability: both negate comprehension only.
